## Safety

**Never attach real vault exports or paste passwords, TOTP secrets, API keys, or access tokens.** Use synthetic data only; sanitize screenshots, JSON examples, filenames, URLs, and browser output. Do not disclose vulnerability details here—follow [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/Mahmoud217TR/Vaultsort/blob/main/SECURITY.md).

- [ ] No vault data, credentials, or sensitive personal information are included
- [ ] Privacy/storage/network boundaries and unknown JSON properties are preserved
- [ ] Relevant regression tests were added or updated
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, and `git diff --check` pass
- [ ] Applicable documentation and `[Unreleased]` changelog entries were updated

## UI and translations (if applicable)

- [ ] New UI strings have localization keys
- [ ] English translation is included
- [ ] Other affected translations were updated where appropriate
- [ ] RTL behavior was tested if applicable
- [ ] No user-facing strings were unnecessarily hardcoded
- [ ] Relevant English/Arabic screens work in light and dark themes
- [ ] Forms, dialogs, tables, navigation, validation, and empty states were checked
- [ ] A native/fluent speaker reviewed a new language, or review is requested
